tests.name: Settings → Privacy (phone) shows "Introduce me to the community" OFF for the test account; read-only, the switch is never flipped
Explicit-choice write + backward-compatible fallback, registration two-choice UI, the Settings switch records on every change, the i18n keys
tests.reason: Staging writes to the production database (CLAUDE.md rules 31-32, 48), so choosing Yes/Not now and registering a member cannot run there. These suites prove what the read-only staging spec cannot: setCommunityIntroOptIn writes both community_intro_opt_in and community_intro_choice_at, and retries with opt-in only on a PGRST204/42703 unknown-column error (so the toggle keeps working before the migration is applied) and throws any other error; registration offers two unselected choices and never blocks when none is chosen; the Settings switch records the choice on every toggle (on AND off). The migration's backfill — recorded choices preserved, unmarked inclusion cleared, idempotent, self-check firing — is proven on PGlite: docs/validation/VTID-05475/outputs/pglite-community-intro-choice-check.txt (22 checks). Nobody is introduced until they choose Yes only AFTER the owner approves and applies the migration (owner stop, collaboration.md §7d).
